Use 'id' directly as a segment 'src' in remix/storyboard/premium specs: recut.source() downloads Drive ids in safe 1 MB chunks and caches them; https URLs are read directly. 'good' lists start times (s) of usable moments. 'mute': the clip's own audio is unusable. Transcripts: pipeline/data/transcripts/<name>_words.json (copy next to the downloaded file as <file>_words.json for remix.py).
